def infer_transform(grid, sc):
    R,C=len(grid),len(grid[0]); pts=[(r,c) for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if grid[r][c]==sc]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts);r1=max(r for r,c in pts);c0=min(c for r,c in pts);c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    shape={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts}; H,W=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
    base=next(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0,sc))
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    matches=[]
    for r in range(R-H+1):
      for c in range(C-W+1):
        if all((grid[r+dr][c+dc]==base)==((dr,dc) in shape) for dr in range(H) for dc in range(W)):
          matches.append((r,c))
          for dr,dc in shape: out[r+dr][c+dc]=sc
    return out,matches,shape,base

program='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0)
    marker = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == marker]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in points]
    sh = max(r for r, c in shape) + 1
    sw = max(c for r, c in shape) + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h-sh+1):
        for c in range(w-sw+1):
            if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    out[r+dr][c+dc] = marker
    return out
'''
